info.title: PaintMixer API
info.description:
PaintMixer computes paint-mixing recipes with a Kubelka-Munk model fitted from
spectrophotometer drawdowns.

* **Paints**: library paints (calibrated) and loaded paints (on dispenser channels).
* **Calibration**: worksheet → measure → upload CSV → validate → fit (background) → model versions.
* **Mixing**: `POST /solve` ranked recipes, `POST /predict` forward model, `GET /gamut`.

Errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

get.description:
Weighting tables (D65, A, F11; CIE 1931 2°) and sRGB constants exactly as the backend uses
them, so clients can run the forward model locally (see ``GET /models/{v}/spectra``).
Series → members with nominal CCT. Switching series in the UI keeps the closest CCT.

post.description: Forward model: predicted opaque-film spectrum and colour of a given mixture.

Predicted swatches mixing paint A into paint B (default: white, i.e. a tint ladder).

A shortcut for the commonest two-paint preview. ``scale: "log"`` dilutes paint A by the same
factor at every step (a tint ladder); a ``linear`` ramp of ``n`` steps equals
``POST /multimix`` with these two paints and ``divisions = n - 1``.

Predicted swatches for every mix of 2-6 paints: a simplex lattice or an N-D grid of levels.

Use it to explore a palette: e.g. ``simplex`` with 3 paints and 10 divisions is the classic
mixing triangle (66 cells); ``grid`` with ``levels`` per paint is an N-dimensional array that
keeps its shape for slicing (``shape``, cell ``index``).

get.description:
a*b* boundary (max chroma per 10° hue bin) at L* slices every 10 units, for the active
model. ``GET /models/{version}/gamut`` does the same for any model version.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

post.description: Dispense the recipe (or pending correction additions) with the simulated dispenser.
Record the measured colour of the mix (spectrum, Lab, or a simulated reading).
One damped Gauss-Newton correction from the latest measurement.
Accept the mix as it is (after a measurement), whatever its dE.
Abandon a job. What is already in the cup stays there and is logged.
